text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perlembagaan Persekutuan
(Persempadanan Bahagian-Bahagian Pilihan Raya) (Negeri Sabah) 2019.

(2)  Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 22 Ogos 2019.

Syor-syor hendaklah berkuat kuasa

2. Syor-syor yang ter kandung dalam laporan Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya
bertarikh 14 Februari 2017 hendaklah berkuat kuasa dari tarikh Perintah ini mula
berkuat kuasa.

Dibuat 20 Ogos 2019
[PM(R)11880/A088/4 Jld.; SPR(R)60 Jld.21; PN(PU2)171C/IX]

Dengan Titah Perintah

                          DATUK SERI DR. ISMAIL BIN HJ. BAKAR
                                                                                                   Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION (DELIMITATION OF CONSTITUENCIES)
(STATE OF SABAH) ORDER 2019

WHEREAS the Election Commission has, in accordance with the requirements of
Clause (2) of Article 113 of the Federal Constitution, conducted a review on the
delimitation of the Federal and State constituencies of the State of Sabah pursuant to
a resolution of the Legislative Assembly of the State of Sabah which passed the
amendment to Clause (2) of Article 14 of the Constitution of the State of Sabah
regarding the composition of the membership of the State Legislative Assembly
from 60 seats to 73 seats, which has been gazetted to be in force on 18 August 2016;

AND WHEREAS the Election Commission has, in accordance with section 8 of
Part II of the Thirteenth Schedule to the Federal Constitution, submitted to
the Prime Minister on 21 February 2017 its report containing recommendations
with respect to the review on the delimitation of the F ederal and State constituencies of
the State of Sabah;

AND WHEREAS the report of the Election Commission has been laid before the
House of Representatives under section 9 of Part II of the Thirteenth Schedule to
the Federal Constitution;

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 12 of Part II of
the Thirteenth Schedule to the Federal Constitution, the Yang di -Pertuan Agong makes
the following order:

Citation and commencement
